title: Every value in the panel has a key diamond
goal: First slice of the user's 'keyframes too!' ask. Beside every value that can change over time in a video, a small diamond starts keying it, the way Premiere's stopwatch does; after that, changing the value at another moment, on the canvas or in the panel, adds a key, and arrows step to the previous and next key.
notes: Split out of keyframe-anything-and-see-and-shape-the-keys-on (user, 2026-09-23) by the manager pass 2026-09-23 06:10; that task keeps its acceptance and closes the set. Extend the model that exists, never a second one: LayerMotion / MotionProperty / MotionStop in Sources/PhotonzCore/LayerMotion.swift already play once on a timed layer (see the done task transitions-at-a-cut-and-effects-you-can-control: 'effects over time invented nothing'). MotionProperty today covers position, scale, rotation, opacity, color, strokeWidth, blur; this slice adds crop, cornerRadius, shadow, textSize, volume, and effect amounts. The canvas-drag-makes-a-key path is built here; move-a-layer-from-a-to-b then puts those keys on the new track. Deps: the video editor must be on at defaults first (a-recording-opens-in-the-video-editor-for-real-i) and the mocks must be the user's (the-video-mocks-are-the-user-s-again-and-d18-is).
acceptance: A layer in a recording document shows a key diamond beside position, scale, rotation, opacity, crop, corner radius, blur, shadow, colour, text size, audio volume and effect amounts; clicking it starts keying that value with a key at the playhead

With keying on, moving the playhead and changing the value on the canvas or in the panel adds a key; the diamond is filled on a key and hollow between keys, with previous and next key arrows beside it
The picture and the export both show the value moving between keys, checked by a render test and an export test that reads a frame back
Undo removes a key in one step, and clicking a lit diamond turns keying off for that value after asking if keys would be lost
Reachable at Next defaults with no flag changed: a walk with no flags keys a title's scale at two moments and photographs the panel and the canvas between them
Side by side with the keyframe drawing in the video-motion mock, every difference listed in the audit; audit written under queue/audits/
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Adversarial pre-build: (1) the mock's diamond removes the key under the playhead when filled, while this task's acceptance (the user's words) makes the diamond Premiere's stopwatch, where clicking a lit one turns keying off after asking; built the acceptance, with add/remove-one-key on the row's right-click menu, and listed it as a mock difference. (2) A keyed position is absolute, so a canvas drag has to be folded into a key live and on mouse-up or the layer would not follow the hand. (3) The canvas handles are drawn at the layer's own frame, not the animated one: a keyed layer's handles can sit away from its picture between keys (checked below). (4) Volume already has keyed level points that playback and export follow, so the volume diamond writes those, not a second curve. (5) Crop has no animatable value type yet (a rectangle) and glow is not in the mock's catalogue: crop left for a follow-up.
